title: DetoxAI: a Python Toolkit for Debiasing Deep Learning Models in Computer Vision
abstract: arXiv:2505.05492v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: While machine learning fairness has made significant progress in recent years, most existing solutions focus on tabular data and are poorly suited for vision-based classification tasks, which rely heavily on deep learning. To bridge this gap, we introduce DetoxAI, an open-source Python library for improving fairness in deep learning vision classifiers through post-hoc debiasing. DetoxAI implements state-of-the-art debiasing algorithms, fairness metrics, and visualization tools. It supports debiasing via interventions in internal representations and includes attribution-based visualization tools and quantitative algorithmic fairness metrics to show how bias is mitigated. This paper presents the motivation, design, and use cases of DetoxAI, demonstrating its tangible value to engineers and researchers.

translated_title: DetoxAI：一个用于计算机视觉中深度学习模型去偏的Python工具包
translated_abstract: 尽管机器学习公平性近年来取得了显著进展，但大多数现有解决方案主要针对表格数据，难以适用于高度依赖深度学习的视觉分类任务。为弥合这一差距，我们推出了DetoxAI，这是一个开源Python库，旨在通过事后去偏（post-hoc debiasing）来提升深度学习视觉分类器的公平性。DetoxAI实现了最先进的去偏算法、公平性指标和可视化工具。它支持通过对内部表征进行干预来实现去偏，并包含基于归因的可视化工具和量化的算法公平性指标，以展示偏差是如何被缓解的。本文介绍了DetoxAI的动机、设计和用例，展示了其对工程师和研究人员的实际价值。
tldr: DetoxAI是一个开源Python工具包，通过内部表征干预等先进去偏算法、公平性指标和基于归因的可视化工具，专门用于提升深度学习计算机视觉分类器的公平性。
en_tdlr: DetoxAI is an open-source Python toolkit that improves the fairness of deep learning computer vision classifiers through state-of-the-art post-hoc debiasing algorithms, fairness metrics, and attribution-based visualization tools.
